propositions: The completion verifier reads a stale local ticket snapshot because close_precheck pins the ticket store with fetch=False, causing materialize_tickets to use the main repo's stale local refs/heads/tickets mirror instead of the live .tickets-tracker store HEAD.

The verifier's fenced context to the model comes from the live store while its show_ticket call reads the pinned stale snapshot, causing disagreement and allowing the model to cite false ticket state (status open, comments 0) as evidence.

A non-PASS verdict with empty findings is coerced to FAIL and synthesizes a placeholder criterion (unspecified) rather than reporting "no verdict obtainable", leaving operators with no remediation path.
The ticket store pin must resolve to the live tracker repo HEAD at close time for immutability and sigability while eliminating staleness.
The completion verification framework lacks a verdict_obtainable signal to distinguish verifier faults from genuine unmet criteria, conflating parse failures with substantive gate failures.
